mail.common.footer: This is an automated message from {app_name}. Please do not reply.
mail.common.link_fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:
mail.auth.magic_link.subject: Your {app_name} sign-in link
mail.auth.magic_link.intro: Use the link below to sign in to {app_name}. It works once and expires in {expires_minutes} minutes.
mail.auth.magic_link.outro: If you did not ask for this link, you can ignore this e-mail.
mail.auth.password_reset.subject: Reset your {app_name} password
mail.auth.password_reset.intro: Use the link below to choose a new password for {app_name}. It works once and expires in {expires_minutes} minutes.
mail.auth.password_reset.outro: If you did not ask to reset your password, you can ignore this e-mail. Your password stays as it is.
mail.auth.password_changed.subject: Your {app_name} password was changed
mail.auth.password_changed.intro: The password of your {app_name} account was just changed. You have been signed out on all devices; sign in again with the new password.
mail.auth.password_changed.outro: If you did not change your password, reset it now from the sign-in page (Forgot password?) and tell your administrator.
mail.admin.project_invite.subject: You are invited to project {project_code} on {app_name}
mail.admin.project_invite.intro: {inviter_name} invited you to the project {project_code} {project_name} on {app_name}. Use the link below to join. If you do not have a password yet, you choose one there. The link works once and expires on {expires_at}.
mail.admin.project_invite.outro: This link is personal: do not forward it. If you did not expect this invitation, you can ignore this e-mail.
mail.access_requests.approved.subject: Your access request for project {project_code} on {app_name} was approved
mail.access_requests.approved.intro: Your request for access to the project {project_code} {project_name} on {app_name} was approved. The project is in your project list the next time you sign in.
mail.access_requests.approved.outro: If you did not ask for access to this project, tell your administrator.
mail.access_requests.rejected.subject: Your access request for project {project_code} on {app_name} was declined
mail.access_requests.rejected.intro: Your request for access to the project {project_code} {project_name} on {app_name} was declined. The reason given: {reason}
mail.access_requests.rejected.outro: You can see the request in the lobby, and request access again from there.
